# Nazam LLC

> Wyoming-based technology consultancy: AI automations & agents, Amazon & Walmart marketplace management, app & web development, and financial intelligence education.

Nazam LLC is an operator-led technology consultancy founded by Muhammad Nazam — a software developer, Scrum Master, and former Amazon FBA seller. The firm runs four service lines under one roof: AI automations and autonomous agents, Amazon and Walmart marketplace management, custom app and web development, and financial intelligence / investing education. Every engagement is tied to a clear, measurable outcome defined before work begins.

Primary URL: https://nazamllc.com/
Contact: admin@nazamllc.com
Founder: Muhammad Nazam
Founder profile: https://linkedin.com/in/muhammad-nazam
Area served: United States (remote, works internationally too)
Legal structure: Wyoming LLC, established 2025

## Services

- AI Automations & Agents — n8n workflows, autonomous AI agents (Claude, OpenAI), and custom automation systems that cut operational overhead, often by 40% or more.
- Amazon & Walmart Marketplace Management — full account management, suspended account recovery, product hunting, PPC management, and multi-channel launch strategy.
- App & Web Development — mobile apps, web platforms, and AI-powered applications built with React, FastAPI, and Python, from concept to launch.
- Financial Intelligence — stock market education covering sector rotation, technical analysis, and AI tools for retail investors; free resources, no upsell.

## Documented Outcomes (Labs)

- E-Commerce Seller: automation reclaimed 2.5 of 3 daily hours previously spent on PPC and messages, with no revenue loss.
- Client Onboarding: a marketing agency's onboarding process cut from 4 hours to 20 minutes via a contract-signature-triggered workflow.
- Lead Generation 3×: an AI agent monitors communities, classifies leads, and drafts outreach so sales reps focus on conversations instead of prospecting.
- FB AI Lead Agent: an autonomous desktop app monitors Facebook groups, classifies prospects by pain level, and drafts human-like replies — live in production.
- AI Finance Platform (in development, 2026): a web platform applying sector rotation models and AI-assisted technical analysis for retail investors.

## Method

Four-stage, iterative engagement loop: Discover (free 30-minute strategy call) → Scope (written scope, fixed price, no hourly billing) → Build (two-week sprint cycles) → Ship (deploy, document, full handover — client owns all code, infrastructure, and credentials, no lock-in).
